name: keewano-ts-workspace
description: React Native + Expo SDK for Keewano AI Analyst - workspace root

scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @keewano/core && npm run build -w @keewano/react-native-sdk
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react-native-sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react-native-expo-sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/node-sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web-sdk/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @keewano/core && npm run build -w @keewano/react-native-sdk && npm run build -w @keewano/react-native-expo-sdk && npm run build -w @keewano/node-sdk && npm run build -w @keewano/web-sdk
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:prod -w @keewano/core && npm run build:prod -w @keewano/react-native-sdk && npm run build:prod -w @keewano/react-native-expo-sdk && npm run build:prod -w @keewano/node-sdk && npm run build:prod -w @keewano/web-sdk
